questions: Are you experiencing pain in your shoulder?
Do you have difficulty raising your arm above your head?
Is the pain worse when you lie on that side at night?
results: 1. limb power and wasting: distal weakness - 4+/5 in the upper limbs, 3/5 in the lower limbs bilaterally
2. foot deformity (pes cavus): pes cavus present
3. genetic testing (targeted panel or exome): heterozygous deletion in MPZ and MFN2; ambiguous copy number decrease in PMP22 exons 2-3 - CMT2A
4. nerve conduction studies / EMG: moderate to severe motor polyneuropathy, axonal more than demyelinating
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A) caused by a mutation in the MFN2 gene

ALTERNATIVES:
1. Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1B (CMT1B) associated with MPZ mutations
2. Hereditary Motor and Sensory Neuropathy (HMSN) of unspecified subtype
dx: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A) caused by a mutation in the MFN2 gene
